name: Coffee C
read: Coffee C Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 264.65, 91 days to expiry 2027-02-10): at-the-money implied vol 36.7%, -2.3 pts vs 2026-11-05. 20-day realized vol 28.3%, so options trade at a premium of 8.4 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +0.3 (balanced). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-10-29 to 2026-11-11) call open interest rose 19,336 and puts fell 3,302; put/call OI 1.62 → 1.32, front futures 276.75 → 264.65. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +409 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 38.5% → 36.7%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 300 calls (3,252 lots) and 200 puts (5,162). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 200 puts +1,362; Mar 27 280 calls +1,001. Biggest cut: Dec 26 260 puts -3,630.
